Hi <!here>! Two big announcements :rotating_light::

1. `Moderation:`Thanks for all of your feedback on moderation. We ran another test that you might have gotten emails for or have seen some impacts to your content. If this happens or you see a long processing experience - `please do not reupload the video`. I will be personally approving/restoring the content, and when that happens you will have multiple of the same video on your profile. Thanks for your patience, we will be making changes today.
2. `Feature Releases:` The app store approved our recent release that fixes several bugs. You should see shorter processing times and a new UX providing processing status. In the next release we will be releasing post thumbnails and post drafts.
